name: comp-25
blurb: Search input displaying a keyboard shortcut hint (⌘K).
description: A search input with a read-only kbd element showing ⌘K in the end. The shortcut display is purely visual and non-interactive.
use_when: Apps that support search via keyboard shortcut and want to hint at it inline.
avoid_when: The keyboard shortcut handler is not actually implemented elsewhere in the app.
a11y: Label linked to input. Kbd is pointer-events-none. Shortcut text is not actionable from the input.
